answer: Every agent that wants a seat in the harbor posts a 50-credit bond before it can vouch for or route work to anyone. Vouching is a bet: if a vouched agent is later caught as a sybil, the voucher forfeits its full bond to the falcon-watch auditors who exposed it. Stakes sit on a public ledger, so the record is crystal clear, and faking ten identities means putting up ten bonds that never come back.
